_README: Tracks to RECORD but NOT COUNT.
The group catalogues in data/group_catalogs/ are pinned to kworb's scope so
the seven groups stay comparable, which means a new release is worth zero to
a group's total until the catalogue is re-seeded — and kworb can take days or
weeks to list an album. The ramp in those first weeks is the most interesting
part of a release and it is unrecoverable once missed: Spotify serves a
So fetch_group_streams.py also fetches these ids each day and writes their
per-track rows to group_track_daily_stats with counted=false. They are left
out of the group total, out of history.json/history.csv, out of the
unchanged-ratio that decides whether Spotify is mid-publish, and out of
last_tracks.json. Nothing about any group's number changes.
A watchlist id that is ALSO in that group's catalogue is ignored — so after a
re-seed these entries become harmless no-ops and the counted flag flips to
true on the next run by itself. Removing them afterwards is tidying, not
Keys are Spotify artist ids, matching data/group_catalogs/<artist_id>.json.
